text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... My dearest wish—has 
been thwarted?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: And the one who blocked it was...

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
The highly anticipated Mejiro showdown! 
The victor is Mejiro Ryan! It's Mejiro 
Ryan!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant, pant*... I can't... go on, 
Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I can't... breathe. Every muscle in my 
body is...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Y... es... This distance... and this 
battle... really were tough...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
My body feels like... it's gonna break 
into pieces... *pant*, *wheeze*, *gasp*...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If you're willing to go that far, then I 
suppose I have no choice.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: M-McQueen...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"I have never felt so frustrated in all my 
life. And yet..."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
If someone had to stand in the way of my 
lifelong dream, I'm glad it was you...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Only if I had to choose, that is! 
Truthfully, it's not fine at all!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: S-Sorry, McQueen... But...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I don't regret it. It was an important 
race for me, too.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...Naturally. If you were to say you 
regretted it now, I would never forgive 
you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Are you aware? From now on, you are the 
one being chased by me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
That's true... I don't know how much I can 
do, but...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it my all! Just like you've 
always done for me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: I would dearly love for you to do so.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I shall step right into your 
specialty distance."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Well then, good day to you.

Overcoming the barrier of aptitude with a 
fierce run, Mejiro Ryan claims the first 
victory.

Next, we set our sights on medium 
distance—the Takarazuka Kinen. After 
today's magnificent run, placing high in 
the fan voting isn't just a dream.
